reviewType: AI semantic review; not human-expert ground truth
reviewer: Primary Codex assistant, after Luna annotation and targeted second-pass review
reviewScope: Read all 237 original exact meanings and their proposed category labels.
Read all 180 AI-authored definitions and labels; inspected the visual/nonvisual evidence boundaries.
Corrected POS shortcuts, incidental secondary labels, mixed senses and unsupported visual claims.
No actual images were annotated and no human-expert review is claimed.
policyDecisions: Use six overlapping evidence categories and sigmoid membership targets; abstract is separate from prediction uncertainty.
Classify the exact selected definition. A noun can describe a process and a verb can describe a state.
Use entity for the referent as target; do not add it to every property/action merely because an entity bears the property or performs the action.
Use relation where referent roles/configuration define the meaning, not merely because a medium or background is present.
Structures can be entity+place when recognized both as a referent and an environmental arrangement; ordinary rooms/landscapes use place.
Private mental feelings and normative/temporal claims require nonvisual context; do not infer them from appearance alone.
Definition-proposed misleading alternatives are NOT independently verified negative image labels and are excluded from final training records.
Preserve legacy provenance; quarantine connected headword/family components crossing old splits.
Group reviewed close paraphrases and antonym contrasts in the authored supplement; these grouping decisions precede any model fit.

audit.note: Integrity audit only. AI labels are a reviewed pilot, not human-expert truth or image-quality evidence.
